gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Open curves leave daylight inside every bowl, so this sans-serif reads approachably. Noto Sans Sunuwar handles the quiet, low-contrast text work, while Neon glows hardest in stout pipe-cleaner strokes with tall, stamped-metal lowercase.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagr: Noto Sans Syloti Nagri reads short and sturdy, with a tall x-height. Neon hums along at a flat, constant line weight, while the body can take a little extra size to let its open-bowled a breathe.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Neon draws every stroke at a single width, stems and joins alike, with tall lowercase like stamped metal. Noto Sans Syriac then softens the glow with its rounded, glass-bulb bowls.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-syriac-east: Glowing, stout lines carry Neon, with no swell where a curve turns the corner. Noto Sans Syriac Eastern keeps its curve endings well apart, and that open, approachable texture against Neon's glow is the whole appeal.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-syriac-west: Noto Sans Syriac Western reads like a modern sans-serif with terminals held far from the stroke, small letters dense with height. Neon draws bowls at stem thickness, a glowing uniformity against that body.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Wirelike glow: Neon keeps every stroke to one thickness, while Noto Sans Tagalog lets its lowercase dominate the line. Over paragraphs, its generous curves keep the text moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Vibrant and plotter-pen precise, Neon draws a single-weight line, tall and stamped-looking, with open spacing throughout. But Noto Sans Tagbanwa sits beside it with open curves and clear gaps, a modern counterweight.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Every stroke of Neon stays wirelike and uniform, glowing against open spacing. Noto Sans Tai Le tapers its ink strokes before they touch, so paragraphs of it move along softly and approachably.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Neon gives every stroke a pipe-cleaner wiriness, glowing and vibrant, with tall lowercase like stamped metal type. Noto Sans Tai Tham adds chalk-board lowercase with a clearly visible c.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Noto Sans Tai Viet reads compact and approachable, with short ascenders, terminals pulled back from the curve, and a tall x-height. Yet Neon draws diagonals to match its stems, so the body can stay modest in size.
